name: Huawei indicated price (China channel) price page for huawei-ascend-950dt
notes: Huawei lifted the indicated 950DT card price to >250,000 CNY ($37,255) from 150,653 CNY, a ~60% hike driven by HBM cost - reported by Reuters and corroborated by TrendForce/Igor'sLAB (Sep 2026). Volume production is Q4 2026, so this is an indicated/channel price rather than a shipped-street price; no secondary market yet. Not available to US buyers (export controls).
